title: Hip Hop Dance For Beginners- BANKHEAD BOUNCE

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses an encouraging and friendly tone, introducing foundational hip-hop steps with clear verbal counting and gradual tempo increases. He breaks down movements step-by-step and encourages personal expression and style.

lesson_structure.note: Instructor introduces himself and the dance style.
Montage of dance performances and classes.
Instructor gives background history of the Bankhead Bounce.
Demonstrating the basic shoulder bounce movement.
Adding arm positions with cross and open movements.

cues: Let's pick up the speed a little bit

steps_taught.name: Bankhead Bounce
steps_taught.description: Bouncing shoulders up and down with optional arm crossings.

what_works: Gradual increase in speed helps learners follow along.
Demonstrating from both front and back views.

quotes.text: At the same time, you got to add your own little swag.
Remember, it's a social party dance so you just vibing out to the music.
